item.water.name: Water Trash Collector
item.water.desc: Place it on open water like a crab pot. It automatically fishes up trash every day. Only one collector per water body. Tap (or right-click) to open the water overview.
item.land.name: Trash Recycler
item.land.desc: Load trash and fuel (coal or wood) to recycle trash into useful resources. Coal/wood from your backpack automatically goes to the fuel slot; other items queue automatically. Each batch processes up to 10 items and can mix different trash types; non-recyclables just sit in the queue unprocessed. Tap (or right-click) to open the panel.
item.cartridge.name: Purifier Cartridge
item.cartridge.desc: Tap (or right-click) on open water or a water collector to instantly lower this water body's pollution by 10.
item.filter.name: Heavy-duty Filter
item.filter.desc: Tap (or right-click) a water trash collector to install it. Doubles the collector's daily haul. Only needed once per machine.

ui.effect.low: Effect: fishing hooks less junk; collector sometimes idles

msg.area-unknown: This water body is too small for a collector.
msg.mine-nodeploy: The mine's water resets every day, so a collector won't survive there. Bring Purifier Cartridges into the mines to clean it manually.

ui.monitor.tip.nodeploy: This water body is inside the mines; its water resets daily and collectors can't stay. Lower pollution manually with Purifier Cartridges.
ui.water.title: Water Trash Collector
ui.map.title: Water Overview
ui.trash.tip: Collected trash piles up here. Non-bait items from your backpack are routed here automatically (the machine stops when it's full).
ui.retrieve.tip: Pick up this collector (the trash storage must be empty; leftover bait and any installed Heavy-duty Filter are returned).
ui.retrieve.blocked: Take out all the trash first before picking up the machine.
ui.status.label: Status
ui.pollution.tip: Each piece of trash collected lowers this water body's pollution by 1.
ui.land.title: Trash Recycler
ui.fuel.tip:
Drop coal or wood here for fuel points:
Coal +2, Wood +1.
1 fuel point = 1 batch (up to 10 trash items).
ui.input.tip: Fuel (coal/wood) automatically goes to the fuel slot; other items queue here, up to 24 kinds. Each batch processes up to 10 items and can mix different trash types. Non-recyclables just sit in the queue and are not processed.
ui.warehouse.tip: Tap: take 1 · Long-press: take 10 · Ctrl/Shift+click: take a whole type · "Take All" takes everything
ui.warehouse.empty: The warehouse is empty. Recycled products will be stored here automatically.
ui.progress.idle: Idle: add trash and fuel to start batch processing.
ui.progress.nofuel: Not enough fuel: each batch costs 1 fuel point.
item.monitor.name: Water Monitor Console
item.monitor.desc: Place it on any open land and tap (or right-click) to open the full water overview. Deploy/retrieve water trash collectors remotely, use Purifier Cartridges and Heavy-duty Filters from afar, or open a collector directly to take trash and add bait. Press F1 to inspect the selected water body's collector.
ui.monitor.title: Water Monitor Console
ui.monitor.hint: Click the map to select a water body · Open a collector directly from the buttons · F1 to inspect it

ui.monitor.tip.deploy: Consumes 1 water trash collector from your backpack and deploys it at the water body's default spot.
ui.monitor.tip.retrieve: Remotely retrieves the collector; the machine, bait, trash and any installed filter are all sent back to your backpack.
ui.monitor.tip.cartridge: Consumes 1 Purifier Cartridge and lowers this water body's pollution by 10.
ui.monitor.tip.filter: Consumes 1 Heavy-duty Filter and installs it on the collector (doubles the daily haul).
ui.monitor.tip.uninstall: Break down this console and put it back into your backpack.
